input.summary: Targeted fix to 14.2: delete "revocable"/"non-transferable" and the term limit, add Affiliates and contractors, and permit transfer under Section 13.3.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have conformed the Deliverable licence to the grant in Sections 13.1–13.3, so paid-for Deliverables are licensed perpetually and irrevocably to us, our Affiliates and our contractors, and remain transferable to an Affiliate or successor. A revocable, term-limited, non-transferable licence would leave us unable to keep using work product we paid to have created; if helpful, we can accept coverage of Affiliates on written notice and transfer limited to a successor in an M&A transaction.

ops.oldText: Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence
ops.newText: Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on its behalf receive a perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid licence

ops.oldText: a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: a Deliverable, transferable to an Affiliate or successor in accordance with Section 13.3.
